headline: Indonesia Cuts Natural Gas Exports to Singapore Amid Domestic Priority
summary: Indonesia restricted natural gas exports to Singapore to prioritize domestic demand, amid ongoing friction over regional air pollution from wildfires.
why: Energy exports from Indonesia are critical for Singapore's power generation and industrial sectors, making supply curbs a significant cross-border utility issue.

impacts.name: Singapore
impacts.why: Reduced natural gas inflows tighten domestic energy supplies for downstream users in Singapore.

why_moved: Supply restrictions on cross-border gas pipelines heighten regional energy security concerns and alter supply dynamics.
